final_answer: The main mechanism behind the Transformer architecture is **self-attention**, which allows the model to capture long-range dependencies and contextual relationships between words or tokens in a sequence. Self-attention mechanisms enable the model to focus on relevant parts of the input sequence based on their relationships to other parts, leading to improved performance in tasks such as language translation, text summarization, and machine translation.
